text: A student shall not register for more than 26 credits in any semester during the first two years (Semesters 1–4), unless granted explicit permission by the Dean (Academics).
conditions: Maximum credit load per semester; exceeding requires written Dean approval.

text: A student shall not register for fewer than 12 credits in any regular semester, except in the final semester or under medical/special circumstances approved by the Dean (Academics).
applies_to: B.Tech all programmes, all regular semesters
conditions: Minimum credit load per regular semester; exceptions require Dean approval.

text: In the third year onwards (Semesters 5–8), a student in good standing (CGPA ≥ 7.0) may register for up to 28 credits in a semester with prior approval.
applies_to: B.Tech all programmes, Semesters 5–8, students with CGPA ≥ 7.0
conditions: Enhanced credit limit for academically strong students in later semesters; requires prior approval.

text: Eligibility criteria for a Minor programme at IIT Bhilai require completion of a specified number of additional elective courses (typically 5 courses / 20 credits) in the chosen discipline beyond the student's major programme requirements.
applies_to: B.Tech all programmes seeking a Minor
conditions: Student must complete the prescribed set of minor courses; specific CGPA eligibility criteria not explicitly confirmed in publicly accessible documents as of retrieval date.

text: UNRESOLVED: The minimum CGPA threshold (if any) required for a student to be eligible to pursue a Minor programme at IIT Bhilai could not be confirmed from publicly accessible official documents as of the retrieval date.
conditions: This entry records an unresolved data gap. The source document may contain further conditions but was not fully parseable from public access.

text: A student may not register for a course unless all hard prerequisites listed in the official curriculum for that course have been completed with a passing grade.
conditions: Applies to hard prerequisites only. Recommended prerequisites do not block registration.
page_or_section: Section on Course Registration and Prerequisites

text: In the event that a student has not completed a prerequisite course due to exceptional circumstances (such as a medical leave), the student may apply to the Department Academic Committee (DAC) for a prerequisite waiver.
conditions: Waiver requires DAC approval; granted on a case-by-case basis.
page_or_section: Section on Course Registration and Prerequisites

text: Course registration is done online through the academic portal during the designated registration window announced by the Academic Office. Late registration attracts a penalty fee.
conditions: Registration must be completed within the announced window.

text: IIT Bhilai permits students to earn academic credit by completing NPTEL/SWAYAM courses, subject to prior approval from the Department Academic Committee (DAC) and the Academic Office. The number of credits transferable is determined by the credit equivalence policy.
conditions: Prior approval required; course must be approved before enrolment. Credit equivalence subject to departmental assessment.

text: A student who completes a NPTEL/SWAYAM course with a minimum score as specified by the NPTEL portal (typically ≥ 40% in the proctored exam) and submits the certificate to the Academic Office within the specified deadline is eligible for credit transfer consideration.
applies_to: B.Tech all programmes seeking NPTEL credit transfer
conditions: Must achieve minimum passing score in NPTEL proctored examination; certificate submission deadline must be met.

text: NPTEL/SWAYAM credits earned and transferred to the academic record may be counted towards elective credit requirements of the B.Tech programme, but generally may not substitute for core programme courses without special approval.
conditions: NPTEL credits count towards electives, not cores, unless specially approved.

text: IIT Bhilai follows a 10-point grading scale. The passing grade in a course is D (5 grade points). A student obtaining F (0 grade points) has failed the course and must repeat it.
conditions: Minimum passing grade is D (grade point 5); F grade requires course repetition.

text: A student will normally not be allowed to register and program will be auto terminated if (i) his/her CGPA falls below 4.0 (ii) his/her CGPA falls below 4.5 for three consecutive semesters.
conditions: Registration restriction and automatic programme termination if CGPA falls below 4.0 or below 4.5 for three consecutive semesters.
page_or_section: Section on Academic Standing, Registration Restriction and Termination
